llm.summary: This is an instruction-only PR review memory skill that openly stores selected review knowledge for later reuse.

dimensions.detail: The capability matches the stated purpose: capture, classify, search, export, and resurface PR review decisions and patterns. The captured content can include sensitive engineering context, but that is central to the skill's purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The artifacts disclose automatic capture after a PR review, manual capture commands, GitHub posting through the related review workflow, and export examples. These are state-changing behaviors, but they are not hidden or purpose-mismatched.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains markdown instruction files only, with no executable scripts, dependency installs, install-time hooks, or obfuscated code.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Metadata and tags indicate related OAuth or sensitive credentials may be needed for PR/GitHub workflows. That access is coherent with PR review integration, but should be narrowly scoped.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Persistent review memory, indexes, backlinks, and retention tiers are explicitly described and proportionate to a knowledge-capture skill, but users should understand the retention and visibility model.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you want PR review findings and decisions retained beyond the current session. Confirm where the memory palace stores entries, who can read them, whether automatic capture is enabled, and that any GitHub token or OAuth grant is limited to the repositories and PR actions needed.
llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: The cited export and persistence behavior is real, but it is part of the documented review-chamber workflow rather than hidden or unrelated behavior. It supports user guidance about file writes and long-term storage, not a Review verdict.
[static-scan] expected: Static scan reported no findings, and local inspection found only non-executable markdown artifacts.
[virustotal] expected: VirusTotal status is pending and provides no artifact-backed negative signal.
